My wife and I witnessed the Cal’s k9 Clips van instigating serious road rage while on our morning walk through our neighborhood today. The van was tailgating the car in front of it while laying on the horn non stop for several blocks drawing the attention of everyone on the street. It was both a nuisance and incredibly dangerous. Ironically, behaving this way with large “Cal’s k9 Clips” branding on the side of the van. Snapped a pic and felt compelled to share.
